landing.hero_subtitle_1: Experience the Bible as a living conversation. Chat with our AI Pastor 24/7 to uncover deep theological insights with the world's most engaging study companion.
landing.cta_section_desc: Try Vagabond Faith AI free. No credit card required.
landing.features_title: Powerful Features for Your Spiritual Journey
landing.features_subtitle: Everything you need to study, reflect, and grow — designed for life on the move.
landing.feature_insights_desc: Get AI-powered explanations of any verse with historical context, cultural background, and practical application.
landing.feature_chat_desc: Have meaningful conversations about faith, get guidance, and explore biblical wisdom with our AI pastor.
landing.feature_search_desc: Find any verse instantly. Search by keyword, topic, or theme across the entire Bible.
landing.feature_notes_desc: Save your reflections, bookmark favorite verses, and build your personal study journal.
landing.feature_translations_desc: Access multiple Bible translations side-by-side. Compare verses across KJV, NIV, ESV, and more.
landing.feature_travelers_desc: A portable powerhouse for deep study. Access your AI pastor and profound scripture insights anywhere, anytime—whether you're in a coffee shop or off the grid.
landing.about_p1: Vagabond Faith is more than a reader; it's a mentor. We've combined the timeless wisdom of Scripture with cutting-edge AI to create a responsive study experience. It's for the seeker who wants more than a daily verse—it's for those who want a partner in their spiritual growth. No building required.
landing.community_desc: You aren't alone on this journey of discovery. Join a growing community of seekers, students, and nomads who are using AI to dive deeper into faith. Share your insights, ask tough questions, and find your tribe.
landing.footer_tagline: Your AI-powered scripture companion and interactive study tool for life on the move.
landing.footer_project_by: A project by The Traveling Church
landing.footer_copyright: Vagabond Faith AI. All rights reserved.
